summary: Frontend-only Playwright retest of the unified .pf-toast flash system (Laravel 12 + Inertia + Vue3 'artirdim') on the public preview URL. All 5 requested scenarios PASS: (1) admin user create (/admin/users/create, user-save-2) and delete (user-delete-{id} + .swal2-confirm) show ONLY a bottom-right .pf-toast, zero visible .pf-alert-success/.alert-success inline banners (verified on Users/Show landing page, Users/Index, /admin/auctions, /admin/orders); (2) profile 'Genel' save with EMPTY phone now submits (required removed, no native HTML5 bubble, validationMessage empty), no full page reload (window.__marker survived), URL stayed /profile, toast 'Profil bilgileriniz güncellendi.'; (3) category create then delete within toast lifetime → exactly 1 .pf-toast in #pf-toast-host (create toast superseded by delete toast); (4) contact form → single toast, no inline banner, and no toast reappearance while navigating /, /login, /admin/users, /admin/categories (plain navigation produces no toast at all); (5) profile Güvenlik e-mail change form → toast without page reload. Code review confirms no flash.success remains in the 6 targeted Vue pages, app-toast.js removes previous .pf-toast before rendering a new one, ProfileController phone rule is 'nullable', and the Vite build (public/build) is newer than the edited sources.

ui_bugs.issue: Dirty-state chip still reads 'Kaydedilmedi' immediately after a successful save (preserveState keeps the dirty flag). Cosmetic state-sync polish, no functional impact.
Legacy blade session('success') alerts still exist but are dead code (routes render via Inertia). Intentionally untouched per main agent note — not re-tested.

action_items: Optional polish: reset the 'Kaydedilmedi' dirty chip after a successful profile save.
Optional cleanup: delete the dead legacy blade views containing session('success') alerts to avoid confusion.
critical_code_review_comments: app-toast.js now clears host.querySelectorAll('.pf-toast') before appending — satisfies the single-toast requirement; keep the router.on visit.only guard in app.js so partial reloads never re-emit flash.
No flash.success template blocks remain in Admin/Users/{Index,Show}.vue, Admin/Auctions/{Index,Show}.vue, Admin/Orders/{Index,Show}.vue (grep-verified) — toast is the single messaging channel.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 requested scenarios pass; 11/11 individual assertions pass)

User create testids: user-name, user-email, user-username, tab 'Rol & Şifre', user-password (+ 2nd input[placeholder='••••••••']), submit user-save-2; delete user-delete-{id} + .swal2-confirm. Toast assertions: document.querySelectorAll('#pf-toast-host .pf-toast'); inline assertion: visible '.pf-alert-success, .alert-success, .alert-au.success'. Full-reload detection via window.__marker.
rca_of_the_issue: All three previously reported defects are fixed and verified live: inline banners removed from the 6 Inertia pages, phone made optional on both frontend (no required attr) and backend ('nullable' in ProfileController), and appToast now supersedes any existing toast so 'oluşturuldu' and 'silindi' can never coexist.
